product_A_natcond.selection_leakage_fix: v4 weighted selection on half B (the scoring half). Audited: no model-ranking inversion on this corpus, but band membership shifted up to 2x. v5 selects on half A only.

prompt_surface: v4-honest (proper-scoring language, per-template resolver-verified criteria, reveal/single-turn/no-news arms); 115 conformance tests
paused_module: 300-world cross-world tail bank (16 classes/5,470 instances) retained, not scored
